National Assembly SimulatorConstituent Assembly 1948 — 22nd Assembly 2024
한국어English日本語

Questions and party positions simplify the main issues of each assembly and may differ from actual party lines and votes. Independents are counted as one bloc and receive no PR seats. Satellite party seats are merged into their parent parties. Party colors follow Namuwiki party colors (as of the election); groups without a known color use a distinguishing color.
